assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Haidian student population figures (tens of thousands of primary/secondary students) are order-of-magnitude estimates based on public reporting; exact official statistics to be confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Any exact student-count claim in the proposal is an estimate, not an official statistic.

assumptions.statement: Design parameters (e.g., AI council pavilion spacing, spine greenbelt width, branch road density, public compute node spacing) are conceptual design targets of this proposal, not statutory standards.
assumptions.impact: Reviewers should treat these as proposal parameters subject to professional refinement.

assumptions.statement: The organizer has not yet released the official SITE_BOUNDARY polygon. The provisional boundary (DATA-SRC-PROVISIONAL-BOUNDARIES-20260605) is used only for generation, display and temporary recalculation; it is not an official redline or a precise-area basis.
assumptions.impact: This is an organizer data gap, not a participant blocker: it does not block content scoring. All area-based metrics must be recalculated when the official geometry is supplied.

assumptions.statement: The organizer has not yet released official polygons for the three key areas (众智园 / AI原点社区 / 大钟寺). Current key-area geometry is provisional and marked official_boundary=false.
assumptions.impact: Organizer data gap, not a participant blocker: content scoring is not blocked. Key-area metrics must be recomputed against official polygons when released.
